Mississippi State Senate
2026 Regular Session

      YEAS AND NAYS On S. B. No. 2838. On motion of Senator Barrett, the rules
were suspended, the bill considered engrossed, read the third time and, the yeas and
nays being taken, it passed, title standing as stated, by the following vote:

       Yeas--Barnett, Barrett, Berry, Blackmon, Blackwell, Blount, Boyd, Brumfield,
Bryan, Butler, Carter, Chassaniol, DeBar, DeLano, DuPree, England, Fillingane,
Gillespie Isom, Harkins, Hickman, Hill, Hopson, Jackson, Johnson, Kirby, Ladner,
McCaughn, McLendon, McMahan, Michel, Mumford, Parks, Pope, Rhodes, Simmons D.
T. (12th), Simmons S. (13th), Sparks, Suber, Thomas, Thompson, Turner-Ford,
Whaley, Wiggins, Williams, Younger. Total--45.
       Nays--Chism, Frazier, Hartness, Norwood, Seymour, Tate, Taylor. Total--7.
       Absent and those not voting----None.
